title: parchment papers
text: parchment papers. Ok.. I purchased these out of laziness.. but honestly there are not enough of them to make it worthwhile in price.  I was going to put them under my holiday loaves in bread holders.  They are really wide and have to be cut.  The best part is that because they arrive flat in a box there is no curl - like you get on a roll.

product_metadata.title: 5x5 Inches 300 Sheets Parchment Paper Squares by Baker’s Signature | Silicone Coated & Unbleached – Ideal for Baking, Wrapping, Freezing & Diamond Painting – Non-Toxic & Comes in Convenient Packaging
features: ✔️ SAVE YOURSELF THE HASSLE – Are you tired of cutting out the perfect parchment squares? We’re here to help. Baker’s Signature silicone coated, and unbleached parchment squares are already precut saving you time and energy for more enjoyable activities than cutting parchment paper. Perfect for baking, separating cookies, freezing meat, wrapping caramel and for arts and crafts projects like diamond painting. Our parchment sheets will take the hassle out of your day, guaranteed!

✔️ THE RIGHT SHEETS FOR BAKING YOUR FAVORITES - Our sheets are greaseproof, waterproof, and non-toxic; they will not tear, rip or soak through. They withstand temperatures up to 450 degrees Fahrenheit, which is higher than most recipes require. Both of the sheets’ sides are coated with non-toxic silicone coating making it a safe choice for your baking needs. Since the food just slides off, no additional oils need to be sprayed on the sheet prior to baking.

✔️ HEALTHY ALTERNATIVE – Made from natural 100% wood pulp, our parchment sheets are a much healthier alternative to Quilon sheets. Quilon contains a chemical called Chromium that can be harmful once ingested. Our parchment squares are compostable and recyclable, making them less harmful for the environment. Baker’s Signature sheets are also not chemically bleached like other brands.

✔️ CONVENIENT PACKAGING – Never want to experience folding parchment paper ever again? Our sheets come in a convenient box that is easy to store without folding or tearing. The box will maintain the sheets’ perfect shape and freshness until next time. Our parchment squares also work great as a food wrap for any to-go food. Need to wrap up your lunch? Baker’s Signature sheets are an excellent way of keeping your carry out fresh. And if your food has gotten cold, the sheets are microwave safe.

✔️ YOUR 100 % SATISFACTION, GUARANTEED – At Baker’s Signature we take customer satisfaction very seriously. If for ANY reason our baking squares don’t live up to your expectations, let us know and we will make sure that the things are made right. Our products are crafted by trusted artisans from carefully selected materials that have been sourced only from approved suppliers. Quality is our priority. Get your parchment baking sheets today and enjoy hassle free baking for the years to come!
